news.title: Blizzard Says WoW Forever Is Its Biggest Launch Ever, But Won’t Say How Big
news.description: Blizzard calls WoW Forever its biggest launch ever by peak concurrent players, but the company shared no numbers.

news.title: Three Mages, a Paladin and a Shaman Hit Level 60 First in WoW Forever
news.description: A full-time AoE grind from level 35 and constant phasing for respawns got this party to World First 60 on the EU Normal ruleset in just TWO days.

news.title: Class and Quest Improvements, Two Racials Tuned, and Much More: WoW Forever Hotfixes, November 6th
news.description: We have a big batch of hotfixes for Forever today, with dungeon, enemy, class, quest, profession changes, and much more.

news.title: First Class Tuning Pass Coming to WoW Forever – November 10th
news.description: Class tuning! The first adjustments arrive to WoW Forever next week, as Hunters, Shamans, and Warlocks get some changes.

news.title: Don’t Forget About These Cheap Pets in WoW Forever
news.description: Pet collectors, don't miss out! Mayhoa Skyhoof and Lil Timmy have unique companions waiting to be added to your collection in WoW Forever.

news.title: All Forever: WoW Weekly, November 2nd – 6th
news.description: We have an all-WoW-Forever-focused weekly overview, as the launch went great, we got a new Twitch Drop, and more!

news.title: Raid Bosses Should Not Require Addons – MrGM Interview
news.description: WoW Forever developers recently revealed that players should be able to comfortably complete raid content without the use of addons.

news.title: Pick Up Quests Before Your WoW Forever Dungeons to Level Faster
news.description: WoW Forever dungeon quests are scattered across Azeroth, some behind questlines. See sources, minimum levels and gear rewards up to level 30.
